# Color Picker

**Figma:** Input/Color-Field, Color-Picker, .Primitives/Input/Color-Swatch (page 373:97258)  
**Import:** `import { ColorField, ColorPicker, ColorSwatch } from "@zen-ds/react";`

Pick or type any colour. ColorField is the Input field (a swatch and the hex) that opens ColorPicker under it; ColorPicker is the panel itself (the saturation × brightness area, the hue, a Format select with its channels, saved colours), inline by default; ColorSwatch is the colour chip that shows a value.

## Use it for
- Brand, theme, chart or shadow colours where any value is allowed (ColorField in a form or settings).
- A property panel or inspector: ColorField layout="inline" (the label inside the field, the swatch after the hex).
- An always-open picker in a panel: an inline ColorPicker; under your own trigger pass open, onOpenChange and anchorRef.
- Showing a colour value next to its name (a legend, a table cell): ColorSwatch with an aria-label.

## Use something else for
- A small curated set (labels, tags, series) → ColorSelector.
- A colour that must mean something (status) → a semantic Badge theme chosen by the system.
- Picking a Zen token for a component → its theme or color prop, not a free colour.

## Figma → React
| Figma | Prop | Values / notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Value | `value · defaultValue · onValueChange` | a hex string "#RRGGBB" (3-digit and lowercase are read; onValueChange always gets 6 upper-case digits) |
| Format | `ColorPicker format / defaultFormat / onFormatChange · ColorField pickerFormat` | hex (default) · rgb · hsl · hsb: the channels the value fields show |
| Saved | `savedColors` | hex values; picking one sets the value (a ColorSelector row) |
| Popover | `ColorPicker open · onOpenChange / onClose · anchorRef` | as DatePicker: without them it is inline (no popover surface) |
| Field | `ColorField colorPicker · size · layout` | colorPicker={false}: a hex field with its swatch; layout="inline" puts the label inside and the swatch at the end |
| Swatch | `ColorSwatch color · size · aria-label` | sm 16 · md 20 · lg 24, following the field's leading icon; decorative unless named |

## Props
Generated from the TypeScript source; full JSON in `docs/api/color-picker.json`.

### ColorPicker
Figma Color-Picker (15708:5927): pick any colour. The Saturation area (saturation → right, brightness → up), the hue on a Slider (Theme=White, its track painted with the spectrum, red held half a thumb at each end so 0° and 360° sit where the thumb stops), a Format select (Hex · RGB · HSL · HSB) with that format's channels as inline Input fields, and the saved colours as a ColorSelector. Panel: Popover/Background, Popover/Border, Effect/Popover, Corner-Radius/Large, padding Spacing/Padding/Small, gap Spacing/Gap/Small; the area is Corner-Radius/XSmall (16 − 12, concentric). Keyboard: the area is a 2D slider (← → saturation, ↑ ↓ brightness, Shift for 10 steps); Escape closes the popover. It opens under ColorField; inline, it is a panel in its container (no popover surface).

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `string` | — | The colour as a hex value (`"#1F6FEB"`; 3-digit and lowercase are read too). Controlled with onValueChange. |
| `defaultValue` | `string` | `"#000000"` | The first colour when uncontrolled. Default `#000000`. |
| `onValueChange` | `(value: string) => void` | — | Called with the new value as `"#RRGGBB"` on every change: dragging the area or the hue, typing a channel, picking a saved colour. |
| `format` | `"hex" \| "rgb" \| "hsl" \| "hsb"` | — | Which channels the value fields show (Figma `Format`): `hex` (default), `rgb`, `hsl` or `hsb`. Controlled with onFormatChange. |
| `defaultFormat` | `"hex" \| "rgb" \| "hsl" \| "hsb"` | `"hex"` |  |
| `onFormatChange` | `(format: ColorFormat) => void` | — |  |
| `savedColors` | `string[]` | `[]` | Saved colours under the fields (Figma `Saved`), as hex values; picking one sets the value. Empty or left out: no row. |
| `open` | `boolean` | `true` | Popover use, as DatePicker: `open` (default true), `onOpenChange` / `onClose` for light dismiss and Escape, `anchorRef` to sit under a field. Without onClose, onOpenChange and anchorRef it is an inline panel in its container. |
| `onOpenChange` | `(open: boolean) => void` | — |  |
| `onClose` | `() => void` | — |  |
| `anchorRef` | `RefObject<HTMLElement \| null>` | — |  |

| `aria-labelledby` | `string` | — |  |

### ColorField
Figma Input/Color-Field (15660:8643): pick or type any colour. The Text-Field anatomy (Label → Field → Help-Text) with a ColorSwatch before the hex (after it with `layout="inline"`, Figma Input/Inline-Field Type=Color); the swatch size follows the field's leading icon (sm 16 in Small, md 20 in Medium and Large, lg 24 in XLarge). A click in the field or ArrowDown opens ColorPicker under it (State=Focused while open); Escape closes it and leaves focus in the field. Typing edits the hex: six digits apply at once, a shorter one on Enter or blur, anything else goes back to the colour. The picker is the same popover on every device (Figma has no mobile pattern for it yet).

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `string` | — | The colour as a hex value (`"#1F6FEB"`; 3-digit and lowercase are read too). Controlled with onValueChange. |
| `defaultValue` | `string` | — |  |
| `onValueChange` | `(value: string) => void` | — | Called with `"#RRGGBB"` when the field holds a new complete colour: a pick in the picker, six typed digits, or a shorter hex completed on Enter or blur. |
| `colorPicker` | `boolean` | `true` | Open ColorPicker under the field (default true) on a click in the field or ArrowDown; false: a hex field with its swatch. |
| `pickerFormat` | `"hex" \| "rgb" \| "hsl" \| "hsb"` | — | The Format the picker opens on: `hex` (default), `rgb`, `hsl` or `hsb`; the person can switch it there. |
| `savedColors` | `string[]` | — | Saved colours in the picker, as hex values (Figma Color-Picker `Saved`). |
| `size` | _HTML attribute_ | `"md"` |  |

| `labelTooltip` | `boolean \| ReactNode` | — |  |
| `labelAction` | `ReactNode` | — |  |
| `helpTheme` | `"neutral" \| "negative" \| "warning" \| "positive"` | — | Figma Help-Text Theme for `helpText`: Neutral (default) · Warning · Positive · Negative. `error` always renders Negative. |
| `helpIcon` | `boolean` | — | Figma Help-Text `Icon` axis (default on). |
| `characterLimit` | `ReactNode \| true` | — | Figma Help-Text `Character-Limitation`: custom text (e.g. "12/100"), or `true` to count the value against `maxLength`. |
| `error` | `ReactNode` | — |  |
| `errorMessage` | `ReactNode` | — | **Deprecated:** Use error (same meaning).  |
| `state` | `"default" \| "hover" \| "focused" \| "typing" \| "inputted" \| "read-only" \| "disabled" \| "inputted-error" \| "blank-error" \| "error"` | — |  |
| `trailing` | `IconName \| ReactNode` | — | After the value: an icon name (sized to the field) or any node (a unit, a picker, an action). |

Written by Zen Studio; app code sets label / helpText / leading / trailing. |

### ColorSwatch
Figma `.Primitives/Input/Color-Swatch` (15659:110090): the colour chip of a colour value, inside ColorField, an inline colour field and ColorPicker. One shape: the value is the fill and an inside 1px Border/Neutral/Subtle keeps white or canvas-coloured values visible. Size: Element-Size/Popular Small 16 · Base 20 · Medium 24. Radius is concentric with the field around it: Corner-Radius/XSmall at sm (12 − 8), 2XSmall at md and lg (12 − 10, 16 − 14). For picking one colour from a set use ColorSelector; this chip only shows a value.

Also accepts `Omit<HTMLAttributes<HTMLSpanElement>, "color" | "children">`.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `color` (required) | `string` | — | The colour it shows: any CSS colour, usually the value of a colour field (`"#1F6FEB"`) or a token (`var(--zen-…)`). |
| `size` | `"sm" \| "md" \| "lg" \| "small" \| "medium" \| "large"` | `"md"` | Follows the leading icon of the field it sits in: sm 16 (Small fields), md 20 (Medium and Large fields, default), lg 24 (XLarge fields). Short or Figma spelling. |
| `aria-label` | `string` | — | Names the swatch for assistive technology (e.g. "Brand colour, #1F6FEB"). Without it the swatch is decorative. |
| `ref` | `Ref<HTMLSpanElement>` | — | The swatch's `<span>`. |

Object shapes the props above refer to.

```ts
type ColorFormat = "hex" | "rgb" | "hsl" | "hsb"
```

## Keyboard
| Keys | Action |
| --- | --- |
| ↓ (in ColorField) | Open the picker and move to its area |
| ← / → | Area: saturation (Shift: 10 steps); Hue slider: hue |
| ↑ / ↓ | Area: brightness (Shift: 10 steps) |
| Enter | Channel field: apply the typed value |
| Escape | Drop a channel edit; else close the popover, focus returns to the field (a Dialog around it stays open) |

## ✅ Do
- Give ColorField a label that names what the colour is for ("Brand colour"), not "Colour".
- Keep the picker's saved colours to the palette people reuse (the brand, the last picks), 6 at most so they fit one row.
- Pass hex values ("#1F6FEB") to value and savedColors; store the hex the field returns.

## ❌ Don't
- Don't use ColorField to pick a status or a Zen token: those come from the system (harness: color-picker/hex-value).
- Don't pass a CSS colour name, rgb() or a token as ColorField or ColorPicker value: the field shows and returns a hex (harness: color-picker/hex-value).
- Don't place a ColorSwatch as the only cue of meaning; name it or show the value beside it.

## Accessibility
- ColorField is an APG combobox that opens a dialog: role="combobox", aria-haspopup="dialog", aria-expanded; ArrowDown opens the picker and focuses its area; Escape closes it and focus returns to the field.
- The saturation × brightness area is a slider named "Saturation and brightness" whose value text reads both ("Saturation 87%, brightness 92%"); the hue is a Slider; each channel field is named in full ("Red", "Lightness") while it shows one letter.
- An inline ColorPicker is role="group", a popover role="dialog", named "Choose a colour" unless aria-label or aria-labelledby names it.

## Content
- Hex values are upper-case with a # ("#1F6FEB").

## Harness (`npm run usage:check`)
| Rule | Severity | Checks | Suppress with |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `input/needs-label` | error | Every field has a visible label (or an aria-label when the context labels it). | `zen-allow-unlabelled-input: <reason>` |
| `input/placeholder-not-label` | warn | Placeholder shows an example or format, never repeats the label. | `zen-allow-placeholder-label: <reason>` |
| `color-picker/hex-value` | error | ColorField and ColorPicker hold a hex colour ("#1F6FEB"): a colour name, rgb(), hsl() or a token is not a value they can show or return. | `zen-allow-colour-value: <reason>` |
| `api/deprecated-prop` | warn | A deprecated prop still works but has a canonical name (onValueChange, onCheckedChange, checked, selected, level…); apps get a warning with the replacement. (App mode only; the repo migrates gradually.) | `zen-allow-deprecated: <reason>` |
| `api/overrides-studio-only` | error | `overrides` (Figma instance overrides of the layers a component draws itself: `{ "Sub-Action": { level: "danger" } }`) is written by Zen Studio on the pages it makes; hand-written code sets the component's own props or composes the parts (the user's call, 2026-10-10). | `zen-allow-overrides: <reason>` |
| `interaction/no-noop-handler` | warn | Every interaction a Zen control offers works: no no-op handlers (`() => {}`, `() => undefined`), which leave a field that ignores typing and ↑/↓ or a Dismiss that stays. Chat has chat/no-locked-interaction. | `zen-allow-noop-handler: <reason>` |
| `interaction/controlled-needs-handler` | warn | A controlled prop comes with its change handler (month + onMonthChange, value + onValueChange, open + onOpenChange, pageSize + onPageSizeChange…): without it nothing can change the value and the control is frozen, e.g. a DatePicker whose Previous/Next do nothing. Bare booleans (a fixed preview) and `x ? true : undefined` pins pass. | `zen-allow-controlled-handler: <reason>` |
